description: Unit test class for ImmutableConnection, validating its behavior, immutability, JSON serialization/deserialization, and URI parsing.

classes.name: ImmutableConnectionTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for ImmutableConnection, verifying behaviors such as equality, immutability, JSON serialization/deserialization, and URI parsing.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that ImmutableConnection correctly implements hashCode and equals methods.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Asserts that ImmutableConnection instances are immutable.

methods.name: createMinimalConnectionConfigurationInstance
methods.description: Tests creating a minimal valid Connection instance with essential fields.

methods.name: createInstanceWithNullId
methods.description: Checks that creating a Connection with null ID throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: createInstanceWithNullUri
methods.description: Checks that creating a Connection with null URI throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: getBuilderFromConnectionCoversAllFields
methods.description: Verifies that the builder derived from an existing Connection instance captures all fields correctly.

methods.name: createInstanceWithNullSources
methods.description: Ensures that a null sources list results in NullPointerException.

methods.name: createInstanceWithNullEventTarget
methods.description: Ensures that a null targets list results in NullPointerException.

methods.name: createInstanceWithoutSourceAndEventTarget
methods.description: Checks that building a Connection without sources and targets throws ConnectionConfigurationInvalidException.

methods.name: fromJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that deserializing from JSON produces the expected Connection object.

methods.name: fromJsonWithLegacyMappingContextReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies deserialization from legacy JSON representations with mapping context.

methods.name: fromInvalidJsonFails
methods.description: Checks that invalid JSON missing required fields throws ConnectionConfigurationInvalidException.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Validates that serialization to JSON produces the expected JSON structure.

methods.name: emptyCertificatesLeadToEmptyOptional
methods.description: Verifies that empty trusted certificates result in an empty optional.

methods.name: emptyCertificatesFromJsonLeadToEmptyOptional
methods.description: Checks deserialization with empty trusted certificates results in empty optional.

methods.name: parseUriAsExpected
methods.description: Tests parsing of a standard URI containing all components.

methods.name: parseUriWithoutCredentials
methods.description: Checks parsing of a URI without username and password.

methods.name: parseUriWithoutPath
methods.description: Checks parsing of a URI without a path component.

methods.name: cannotParseUriWithoutPort
methods.description: Ensures that a URI lacking a port throws ConnectionUriInvalidException.

methods.name: cannotParseUriWithoutHost
methods.description: Ensures that a URI lacking a host throws ConnectionUriInvalidException.

methods.name: canParseUriWithUsernameWithoutPassword
methods.description: Verifies that a URI with username but empty password is parsed correctly.

methods.name: canParseUriWithoutUsernameWithPassword
methods.description: Verifies URI parsing with an empty username and a password.

methods.name: uriRegexFailsWithoutProtocol
methods.description: Ensures that URIs missing the scheme cause an exception.

methods.name: toStringDoesNotContainPassword
methods.description: Verifies that the connection's toString method omits the password.
